name: netdust-agent
description: Netdust overlay on superpowers — superpowers is the process workhorse (brainstorm, plan, TDD, review, finish); netdust-agent adds the gates: an intake router (class A–F priced by open decisions + a stakes dial), plan-time gates machine-checked by bin/gate-check.py (threat model, invariants, ground-truth, Source: per FR, deliverable-first ordering, behaviour clusters), build-time gates (tier-based testing through the netdust WP harness, review clusters with independent reviewers, feature tests by an independent test-author after each task group), and a self-contained machine layer (hooks + bin/ scripts, bare python3) that verifies artifacts instead of trusting testimony. 0.18 (the re-thinning): 27 skills cut to 6 thin overlays that actually invoke their superpowers base; verify-budget is telemetry, never a HALT; skills ship with evals; and an on-demand convergence gate (/converge) — the codebase read against specs/<feature>/ for what was promised but never built, gaps appended to tasks.md as a PROPOSED phase behind gate-check + the seam.
